_meta.source: Narutopedia (naruto.fandom.com) via MediaWiki API, plus general franchise knowledge
_meta.note: No canon character biographies. All player/NPC characters in the game are original; canon data here is used only for clans, factions, creatures, items and culture.

clans.name: Uchiha Clan
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: Sharingan (dojutsu; evolves 1 -> 2 -> 3 tomoe, rare Mangekyo Sharingan); strong Fire Release affinity
signature_abilities: Sharingan: read/predict movement, copy observed techniques, see chakra
Mangekyo-tier: black flames, ribcage-like chakra avatar (Susanoo)
clans.crest_description: Uchiwa paper fan: upper half red, lower half white, with a short white handle; usually worn on the back of shirts
clans.typical_appearance: Black/dark hair, pale skin, black eyes that turn red with black tomoe when Sharingan is active; dark-blue or black high-collared shirts with the fan crest on the back, white or dark shorts/pants
clans.compound_description: Walled district on the edge of Konoha with fan crests painted on walls, lanterns and signboards; traditional wooden houses, a shrine (Naka Shrine) with a secret meeting hall under a tatami mat, close to the Military Police headquarters
clans.game_suggestion: Glass-cannon fire/genjutsu duelist. Passive: Sharingan Perception (slow-motion telegraph of enemy attacks, timed-dodge window +X%). Unique: Copy Technique (learn an observed enemy jutsu temporarily or permanently after N observations). Progression milestones: Awaken 1 tomoe (lvl ~10, enhanced dodge), 2 tomoe (copy unlock), 3 tomoe (genjutsu stun on eye contact), Mangekyo as rare endgame quest with eyesight-loss drawback (screen blur stacks when overused).

clans.name: Hyuga Clan
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: Byakugan (dojutsu: near-360-degree vision with one blind spot, x-ray sight, sees chakra pathways and tenketsu); Gentle Fist (Juken) taijutsu
signature_abilities: Byakugan long-range vision and chakra-point detection
Gentle Fist: palm strikes that damage internal organs and seal tenketsu
Eight Trigrams Palm Rotation (spinning chakra dome defense)
Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm (air-pressure palm projectile)
clans.crest_description: Stylised flame/teardrop-like symbol (the clan mark seen on robes); the branch family bears a green 'caged bird' seal on the forehead
clans.typical_appearance: Pale lavender/white pupil-less eyes, veins bulge around eyes when Byakugan is active; long dark hair; traditional light-colored robes or loose white/beige clothes; branch members wear forehead coverings over the caged-bird seal
clans.compound_description: Large, formal traditional estate with a training dojo, tatami halls, koi gardens and strict main-house / branch-house separation
clans.game_suggestion: Precision melee + scout. Passive: Byakugan pulse reveals enemies, traps and weak points through walls in a radius. Unique: Gentle Fist combo that drains enemy chakra and seals a jutsu slot per landed hit; Palm Rotation as a parry/AoE knockback. Milestones: Byakugan range upgrades, 8 -> 16 -> 32 -> 64 Palms combo chain, blind-spot weakness mechanic (attacks from a specific rear angle bypass detection). Optional faction storyline: main vs branch family.

clans.name: Nara Clan
signature_abilities: Shadow Imitation (bind target to mirror your movements)
clans.crest_description: Stylised circular emblem resembling a deer/shadow motif (often rendered as a simple ring-and-line symbol) (approximate; verify against the wiki image before modelling)
clans.typical_appearance: Dark hair tied in a high spiky ponytail, narrow tired-looking eyes, laid-back posture; earrings commonly given by teammates
clans.compound_description: Rural estate in a forest on Konoha's outskirts where the clan raises sacred deer whose antlers are used for medicine; quiet, shady, many trees
clans.game_suggestion: Controller/tactician. Passive: shadow range scales with available shadows (more powerful at dusk, in forests, near large objects; uses the game's lighting system). Unique: Shadow Possession roots a target and forces it to mirror the player. Milestones: multi-target bind, shadow strangle damage, 'Strategist' perk that shows enemy AI intent and party command wheel. Side activity: deer herding/medicine crafting.

clans.name: Akimichi Clan
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: Hiden: Body expansion (Baika no Jutsu), converting calories to chakra
signature_abilities: Butterfly Mode via secret pills (green/yellow/red pills)
clans.crest_description: Kanji for 'food' (食) inside a circle / clan swirl mark worn on armor and scarves
clans.typical_appearance: Large build, swirl marks on the cheeks, spiky reddish-brown hair; red samurai-style armor plating, scarves with the kanji for 'food'
clans.compound_description: Konoha district with barbecue restaurants and big family dining halls; shares strong ties with the Nara and Yamanaka (Ino-Shika-Cho)
clans.game_suggestion: Tank/bruiser. Passive: food items restore extra chakra and grant temporary size buffs (calories as a resource bar). Unique: Expansion stance (larger hitbox, high poise and damage, slower move speed), Human Bullet Tank rolling dash. Milestones: limb expansion, full-body giant form, risky three-pill system (huge buff, then heavy HP penalty). Synergy bonus when partied with Nara/Yamanaka NPCs.

clans.name: Yamanaka Clan
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: Hiden: Mind Body Switch and mind/telepathy techniques; sensory skills
signature_abilities: Mind Body Switch (possess target, own body left vulnerable)
clans.crest_description: Clan symbol often shown as a stylised flower/three-petal mark; family flower shop sign (approximate; verify against the wiki image before modelling)
clans.typical_appearance: Blond hair, pale blue/aqua eyes without visible pupils, purple or light outfits
clans.compound_description: Run the Yamanaka Flower Shop in Konoha; house filled with flowers and herbs; the clan also staffs Konoha's interrogation and intelligence departments
clans.game_suggestion: Support/possession specialist. Passive: telepathic link shows allies' HP and lets the player issue commands to the party. Unique: Mind Body Switch to temporarily control an enemy (player's body becomes AFK and vulnerable). Milestones: longer possession, interrogation minigame to extract mission intel, radio-like map link. Profession: flower/herb gathering feeding potion crafting.

clans.name: Aburame Clan
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: Hiden: Insect symbiosis (kikaichu chakra-eating beetles live inside the body)
signature_abilities: Tracking via female beetle scent markers
clans.crest_description: Clan mark is usually a simple stylised insect/hex shape; often not visibly worn (approximate; verify against the wiki image before modelling)
clans.typical_appearance: Round dark sunglasses, high collars and hooded long coats hiding the face, quiet and logical; insects crawling from skin pores
clans.compound_description: Secluded, dimly lit houses with insect breeding rooms, hives and terrariums
clans.game_suggestion: Summoner/DoT controller. Passive: insect swarm auto-attacks and drains enemy chakra over time. Unique: plant a tracker beetle on an enemy (minimap marker), insect clones as decoys. Milestones: swarm size upgrades, breeding minigame to unlock specialised insect types (poison, explosive, shield). Weakness: fire-based attacks kill swarm units.

clans.name: Inuzuka Clan
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: Hiden: Ninken partnership techniques; enhanced smell/hearing
signature_abilities: Fang Over Fang / Passing Fang (drill-like spinning attacks)
Beast Human Clone (dog turns into a copy of the user)
clans.crest_description: Red fang-like triangle marks on each cheek serve as the clan's identity
clans.typical_appearance: Red fang tattoos on cheeks, slit-like pupils, sharp canines, wild hair, fur-lined hooded jackets; always accompanied by a ninken dog
clans.compound_description: Large kennel compound and veterinary clinic with dog runs, training yards and doghouses
clans.game_suggestion: Pet-class skirmisher. Passive: companion ninken (AI pet) that grows from puppy to giant dog; scent tracking reveals footprints. Unique: combination drill attacks with the pet; 'Beast Clone' turns the pet into a decoy copy of the player. Milestones: pet growth stages, pet gear, fused Two-Headed Wolf transformation. Pet can be revived with a cooldown.

clans.name: Senju Clan
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: Extraordinary chakra/life force; very rare Wood Release (Mokuton) kekkei genkai; medical-ninjutsu aptitude
signature_abilities: Wood Release: tree growth, wooden prisons, wooden golems/dragons
clans.crest_description: Senju crest is a stylised emblem worn on warring-states armor (exact design varies by source); the founding clan's legacy is mainly expressed through the Konoha leaf symbol
clans.typical_appearance: Varied; red armour plates in the warring-states era; known for strong bodies and large chakra reserves
clans.compound_description: Clan was largely absorbed into the general Konoha population; historical sites, founder statues on the Hokage Rock cliff and warring-states battlefield ruins
clans.game_suggestion: Durable all-rounder / rare bloodline unlock. Passive: HP regeneration and larger chakra pool. Unique: Wood Release as a rare legendary skill line (create cover walls, root-binding, wooden clones). Milestones: Wood Release awakening quest, wooden golem summon. Good fit for 'lost bloodline' story arcs.

clans.name: Uzumaki Clan
clans.village: Uzushiogakure (Whirlpool, destroyed); scattered survivors in Konoha and elsewhere
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: Exceptional life force and chakra; master sealing techniques (fuinjutsu); rare Adamantine Sealing Chains
signature_abilities: Advanced sealing jutsu (seal enemies, items, beasts)
clans.crest_description: Red spiral/whirlpool swirl; worn on the back of Konoha flak jackets and as the sign of the ruined village
clans.typical_appearance: Commonly bright red hair, high vitality
clans.compound_description: Ruins of Uzushiogakure: island village of whirlpool seas, shattered spiral walls, sealed vaults; a mask shrine in Konoha holds Uzumaki masks
clans.game_suggestion: Sealing specialist with huge stamina. Passive: chakra pool +50%, slow chakra regen even in combat. Unique: Seal Tags (place seals on terrain to trap, store items, seal summoned creatures or bosses for loot). Milestones: Sealing Chains (grab/pull/bind giant bosses), Jinchuriki-like containment storyline, ruins-exploration dungeon of Uzushio.

clans.name: Sarutobi Clan
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: No kekkei genkai; famed for broad jutsu mastery, Fire Release and the monkey summoning contract (Enma line)
signature_abilities: Fire Release: Burning Ash / ash cloud ignition
clans.crest_description: Sarutobi crest is a stylised circle with fire/monkey motif; clan members strongly linked to Konoha leadership (approximate; verify against the wiki image before modelling)
clans.typical_appearance: No fixed physical traits; often goatees, cigarettes/pipes among elders
clans.compound_description: Traditional Konoha residence near the Hokage administration; dojo for academy-style teaching
clans.game_suggestion: Jack-of-all-trades. Passive: +1 jutsu slot and faster jutsu learning. Unique: monkey summon that transforms into an unbreakable staff weapon. Milestones: unlock five nature-element affinities over time ('The Professor' path).

clans.name: Hatake Clan
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: No kekkei genkai; tantō mastery (White Light Chakra Sabre lineage), Lightning Release, ninken summoning
clans.crest_description: No widely seen crest; recognised by the white chakra sabre
clans.typical_appearance: Silver/white spiky hair, often a face mask
clans.compound_description: Small, modest family home in Konoha; the clan is very small
clans.game_suggestion: Use as a design reference for a 'small-family genius' background: Passive tanto damage bonus, unique lightning-infused blade attacks, ninken summon pack at mid-level.

clans.name: Kaguya Clan
clans.village: Formerly Land of Water / Kirigakure region (clan wiped out in a reckless attack on Kiri)
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: Shikotsumyaku (Dead Bone Pulse): control of bone growth, density and structure
signature_abilities: Bone swords pulled from the arm/spine
Willow / Larch / Clematis Dance (bone spikes from body)
Bracken Dance (forest of bone spikes from the ground)
clans.crest_description: No common crest; identified by two red dots on the forehead
clans.typical_appearance: Two red forehead dots, pale skin, white or light hair; bloodthirsty warrior culture
clans.compound_description: Isolated war-like camp or cave settlement in the Land of Water; bone ornaments, arena-like grounds
clans.game_suggestion: Melee bruiser/self-armor. Passive: bone armor reduces damage, regenerates out of combat. Unique: bone weapons (crafted from own body: sword, spear, drill) that never break. Milestones: bone bullets ranged, Bracken Dance AoE. Drawback idea: rare disease debuff at very high usage.

clans.name: Yuki Clan
clans.village: Land of Water / Kirigakure (persecuted during the Bloody Mist era)
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: Ice Release (Hyoton): combines Wind and Water
signature_abilities: Demonic Ice Mirrors (dome of mirrors you can teleport between)
Senbon acupuncture to induce false death
clans.crest_description: No standard crest; ice/snowflake motif appropriate
clans.typical_appearance: Pale skin, long dark hair, often ANBU-style hunter masks; light kimono-like clothing
clans.compound_description: Hidden snowy villages and huts; forced into secrecy due to bloodline persecution
clans.game_suggestion: Ranged precision/zone control. Passive: senbon crit vs. pressure points, slow on hit. Unique: Ice Mirror dome (trap enemy, teleport between mirrors). Milestones: freezing terrain, ice armour, environmental freeze puzzles (freeze rivers to cross).

clans.name: Hozuki Clan
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: Hydrification Technique (body turns to water); clan secret abilities
signature_abilities: Hydrification (become liquid, immune to physical blows)
clans.typical_appearance: Pale blue/white hair, purple or violet eyes, sharp pointed teeth; carry water bottles to stay hydrated
clans.compound_description: Seaside Kiri houses, misty waterfront docks
clans.game_suggestion: Evasive water fighter. Passive: hydration meter (dodge-roll converts body to water for i-frames; drains hydration; refill from water sources/bottles). Weakness: lightning damage x2. Unique: water gun ranged, muscle pump heavy attack. Milestones: wielding giant blades (affinity with the Swordsmen tree).

clans.name: Kurama Clan
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: Kurama Clan kekkei genkai: extremely powerful genjutsu; rare members make illusory damage physically real
signature_abilities: Mental split personality controlling the power
clans.crest_description: Kurama crest (symbol stylised in the anime); simple formal emblem
clans.compound_description: Wealthy estate with art rooms and sealed chambers
clans.game_suggestion: Illusionist. Passive: genjutsu cast speed. Unique: 'Reality Illusion' — illusions deal real damage. Drawback: sanity/control meter; when it overflows an uncontrolled alter-ego takes over (AI-controlled berserk mode).

clans.name: Chinoike Clan
clans.village: Land of Lightning (mercenaries), later exiled to the Valley of Hell in the Land of Hot Water (anime/novel)
clans.kekkei_genkai_or_hiden: Ketsuryugan (blood dojutsu): manipulate liquids high in iron, especially blood; blood-red eyes
signature_abilities: Blood manipulation: blood weapons, blood bind
clans.crest_description: Red droplet/blood motif (stylised) (approximate; verify against the wiki image before modelling)
clans.typical_appearance: Red eyes with dark ring patterns when active
clans.compound_description: Valley of Hell: dark, hellish canyon of hot springs and red mist where the exiled clan lived
clans.game_suggestion: Dark bloodline/HP-as-resource class. Passive: spend HP instead of chakra for jutsu (high risk). Unique: blood weapons and binding. Milestones: blood genjutsu, life-steal. Natural fit for a villain clan or a cursed-bloodline storyline.

organizations.name: Akatsuki
organizations.description: Small criminal organisation of S-rank missing-nin operating in two-person cells, funding itself through bounty hunting and mercenary work; aim was to capture all tailed beasts and seal them into a giant statue to revive the Ten-Tails. Hideouts in caves sealed by barrier techniques (Five Seals Barrier).
organizations.visual_identity: Black high-collared cloaks with red clouds outlined in white; straw hats with hanging bells/paper strips; slashed (scratched-through) village forehead protectors; purple nail polish; each member wears a ring on a specific finger bearing a single kanji, the ring position corresponding to a pose on the Demonic Statue. Members communicate via a projection technique as 'phantom' silhouettes.
organizations.game_suggestion: Inspire an ORIGINAL criminal syndicate (avoid canon members). Endgame enemy organisation operating in duos; bounty-hunter missions; ring-collecting system (each defeated pair drops a ring; collect a set for a legendary reward). Cloak + rings make a great cosmetic unlock after the main story.

organizations.name: Anbu (Assassination and Tactical Special Forces)
organizations.description: Elite black-ops unit directly under the Kage: assassinations, high-risk missions, guarding the Kage, hunting missing-nin (Hunter-nin corps in other villages dispose of rogue ninja bodies to protect village secrets). Identities hidden.
organizations.visual_identity: Porcelain animal masks (cat, bird, dog, weasel, boar, etc.), grey or black sleeveless armor vests, arm guards, a red spiral tattoo on the left upper arm, black long-sleeved undershirt, straight sword (ninjato) on the back
organizations.game_suggestion: Joinable elite faction at high rank (chunin/jonin). Unlock animal mask customisation, stealth assassination missions, special codename. Rival Hunter-nin from other villages appear as enemies when the player becomes a missing-nin.

organizations.name: Root (Ne)
organizations.description: Secret, officially disbanded Anbu training division that continued underground; members are raised to erase emotions and bound by a cursed seal on the tongue that paralyses them if they reveal secrets. Headquarters deep underground beneath Konoha.
organizations.visual_identity: Anbu-like masks (often blank or with the kanji 'ne'), black outfits, tanto; tongue-seal mark
organizations.game_suggestion: Shadowy mission giver with morally grey quests (high rewards, reputation penalty with village). Possible secret faction route; tongue-seal mechanic that blocks the player from revealing info in dialogue.

organizations.name: Konoha Military Police Force
organizations.description: Police force of Konoha maintaining internal order and arresting criminal ninja, historically run by the Uchiha clan.
organizations.visual_identity: Emblem: Uchiha fan inside a four-pointed star/shuriken shape; dark uniforms with green flak jackets or vests, armbands
organizations.game_suggestion: In-village law enforcement: crime/bounty system (getting caught stealing or fighting in town triggers police NPCs); investigative side-quest chains; joinable as a detective career path.

organizations.name: Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist
organizations.description: Kirigakure's legendary group of seven elite swordsmen each wielding one of the seven famous blades; the swords are passed down to successors. Present the swords as legendary loot (see legendary_weapons).
organizations.visual_identity: Mist headbands, sharp-toothed fighters, swords carried on the back, dark bandages/wraps
organizations.game_suggestion: Legendary-weapon hunt: seven boss duels (original NPC sword-bearers) each dropping one blade. Collecting all seven unlocks a 'Swordsman' title and Mist faction rank.

organizations.name: Samurai of the Land of Iron
organizations.description: Neutral country without a ninja village, defended by samurai who use chakra flowing through their blades. Led by a general (Mifune-style). Hosts neutral summits (Five Kage Summit).
organizations.visual_identity: Full samurai armor with large shoulder plates, horned/crested helmets, flowing capes, kanji emblems; snowy mountain fortress with a giant bridge
organizations.game_suggestion: Neutral region with honor-based duels; samurai enemies parry jutsu and channel chakra into blades (iaido one-hit attacks). Mission giver for escort/diplomacy. Possible samurai class path for the player.

organizations.name: Puppet Brigade (Kugutsu Butai)
organizations.description: Sunagakure organisation of elite puppeteers active at least during the Second Shinobi World War, using chakra threads to control combat puppets loaded with poison blades and hidden weapons; researched a forbidden technique to bring puppets to life (labelled kinjutsu due to its cost).
organizations.visual_identity: Suna clothing, face paint (kabuki-style purple paint), bandaged scrolls carrying puppets, visible chakra threads from fingertips
organizations.game_suggestion: Puppeteer class or faction: craftable modular puppets (arms, blades, poison gas, shields); puppet repair workshop; desert enemy groups using swarms of puppets (target the puppeteer to cut threads).

organizations.name: Hunter-nin (Oinin)
organizations.description: Special tracking units of each village that hunt down missing-nin and destroy their bodies to keep village secrets.
organizations.visual_identity: Village-specific masks (Mist hunter masks with swirl/eye-slit designs), cloaks
organizations.game_suggestion: Bounty-hunter enemies that pursue the player if they betray their village; mission givers for bounty contracts.

organizations.name: Twelve Guardian Ninja
organizations.description: Elite ninja guarding the Fire Daimyo; wear sashes with the kanji for 'fire'.
organizations.game_suggestion: Escort/VIP protection missions for the feudal lord; prestige rank for veteran players.

village_ninja_uniforms.flak_jacket_color: Olive/forest green with scroll pouches on chest, red Uzumaki swirl on back
village_ninja_uniforms.headband_symbol_description: Leaf with spiral (swirl inside a leaf outline with a stem)
village_ninja_uniforms.clothing: Dark navy long-sleeved shirt and pants with a red swirl patch on the shoulders, taped shins/ninja sandals, shuriken holster on thigh; green flak jacket for chunin/jonin

village_ninja_uniforms.flak_jacket_color: Tan/beige with single shoulder strap, simpler cut than Konoha
village_ninja_uniforms.headband_symbol_description: Hourglass shape (two triangles facing each other with a line through the middle)
village_ninja_uniforms.clothing: Loose beige/sand-colored robes, turban-like head cloths and veils against sandstorms, gourds/scrolls for puppets

village_ninja_uniforms.flak_jacket_color: Grey-blue / olive with horizontal ridged lines, collar
village_ninja_uniforms.clothing: Dark shirts with striped camouflage, bandages over the face for some, swords common; wet coastal gear

village_ninja_uniforms.flak_jacket_color: White/cream, one-shoulder strap, no high collar
village_ninja_uniforms.headband_symbol_description: Cloud shape: horizontal lines under a rounded cloud outline
village_ninja_uniforms.clothing: Dark sleeveless or long-sleeved tops, many ninja with tattoos, broadswords; mountain gear

village_ninja_uniforms.flak_jacket_color: Red-brown with a single shoulder strap and one sleeve (left arm)
village_ninja_uniforms.headband_symbol_description: Two rocks/mountain peaks forming stacked shapes
village_ninja_uniforms.clothing: Earth-tone clothing, sleeve on one arm, cloths on the head, rough rugged gear for mountains
Camouflage pants, camouflage-patterned tops, purple rope belts tied in a bow; experimental cursed-seal fighters
Raincoats, breathing apparatus masks, umbrellas, industrial steel towers village

village_ninja_uniforms.headband_symbol_description: Symbol of a waterfall with a stylised drop

tailed_beasts.animal: Tanuki (raccoon dog) made of sand, blue markings
tailed_beasts.element_or_ability: Sand manipulation, Wind Release (Air Bullets); Magnet Release-like sand control; sealing-pattern body
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Desert boss with huge hitbox; arena hazards of quicksand; weak point on forehead; phase 2 when sand armor breaks.

tailed_beasts.animal: Giant cat made of blue/black flames (two-tailed nekomata)
tailed_beasts.element_or_ability: Blue cursed flames, Fire Release, agility
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Fast-moving boss; burning ground puddles; pounce attacks with large frontal hitbox.

tailed_beasts.animal: Giant turtle with coral-like shell and spikes
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Lake/sea boss; shell is invulnerable, expose its face/belly; fog that causes illusions.
Volcano arena; lava geysers, ground-pound shockwaves; hitbox per arm.

tailed_beasts.animal: White dolphin-horse (horse with dolphin head and horns)
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Steam field damage over time; charging attack with long horn hitbox.
Swamp boss; acid trails, bubble projectiles; splits into smaller slugs.

tailed_beasts.animal: Giant rhinoceros beetle-like insect with six wings plus a single wing-shaped tail
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Aerial boss; airborne hitbox, blinding dust clouds, cocoon trap.

tailed_beasts.element_or_ability: Tailed Beast Bomb, ink clouds, physical strength
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Coastal/island boss; tentacle grabs; ink blinds; tentacles are separate targetable hitboxes.

tailed_beasts.element_or_ability: Massive chakra, Tailed Beast Ball, hate-sensing, sealing-ready
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Penultimate super-boss; tails used as sweep attacks; destruction across a whole zone.

tailed_beasts.animal: Primordial monster with one eye (Rinne-Sharingan), many forms; progenitor of the nine beasts
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Optional secret ultimate raid boss (or replace with an original creature to avoid canon).

summons.home: Mount Myoboku (giant mushrooms, toad oil waterfall, Sage training grounds)
summons.traits: Varied sizes from tiny scouts to giant warrior toads carrying swords/pipes; Toad Oil Flame Bullet; Sage Mode training via natural energy
summons.game_suggestion: Summon contract quest at Mount Myoboku; earn Sage Mode buff (natural energy meter: stand still to charge, gain power but risk turning into a toad statue if overfilled).

summons.home: Ryuchi Cave (cave full of giant white snakes)
summons.traits: Huge serpents, swallow and hide summoner, poison, sensing; Sage Mode with snake-like traits
summons.game_suggestion: Dark-path summoning (villains, Sound region). Snake summon to burrow, ambush and swallow enemies.

summons.traits: Katsuyu-type giant slug that splits into many small slugs; healing; acid spray
summons.game_suggestion: Healer summon: small slugs attach to allies for HoT. Medical-ninja quest line.

summons.traits: Excellent sense of smell, tracking, biting to restrain; often wear Konoha headbands/vests
summons.game_suggestion: Early tracking summon; follows scent trails to mission targets.

summons.traits: Aerial transport and scouting; message carriers
summons.game_suggestion: Fast-travel/scouting: summon hawk to reveal a map area or carry the player.

summons.home: Mountain of Monkeys (Enma line, summoned for staff transformations)
summons.traits: Monkey King turns into an unbreakable adamantine staff
summons.game_suggestion: Weapon-summon: monkey transforms into staff, combos with staff skill tree.

summons.traits: Cat ninja that sell ninja tools and weapons, paw prints

summons.game_suggestion: Boss summon for enemy jonin; poison gas area denial.

summons.traits: Crows used for genjutsu, scouting; weasel wind blades
summons.game_suggestion: Genjutsu-aligned summon: crow flocks blinding enemies.

summons.traits: Giant spiders, webs, golden sticky threads
summons.game_suggestion: Forest dungeon trap enemies or player summon for web traps.

summons.animal: Giant animals of the Forest of Death (Training Ground 44)
summons.home: Forest of Death in Konoha: enormous trees, rivers, fenced with 44 gates
summons.traits: Giant tigers, giant centipedes, giant leeches, giant snakes, man-eating bears and insects
summons.game_suggestion: Exam zone filled with wild giant beasts; survival exam event (Heaven/Earth scroll pairing mechanic).

legendary_weapons.name: Kubikiribocho (Executioner's Blade)
legendary_weapons.description: Huge cleaver-like sword with a round hole near the tip (to cut necks) and a semicircle cut near the handle; regenerates damage by absorbing iron from blood of victims
legendary_weapons.game_suggestion: Heavy cleaver: slow, huge damage; durability self-repairs on hit (lifesteal for weapon durability).

legendary_weapons.name: Samehada (Shark Skin)
legendary_weapons.description: Sentient sword covered with scales/bandages, absorbs chakra from enemies and transfers it to the wielder; can choose its owner
legendary_weapons.game_suggestion: Chakra-leeching sword; loyalty system (weapon can reject the player).

legendary_weapons.name: Kiba (Fangs)
legendary_weapons.description: Pair of lightning-imbued twin swords, sharpest of the seven
legendary_weapons.game_suggestion: Dual-wield lightning swords with chain-lightning procs.

legendary_weapons.name: Nuibari (Sewing Needle)
legendary_weapons.description: Long needle-like sword with a long wire attached to the hilt, can stitch multiple enemies together
legendary_weapons.game_suggestion: Piercing + wire pull; skewer multiple enemies in a line and bind them.

legendary_weapons.name: Shibuki (Splash)
legendary_weapons.description: Sword with a scroll of explosive tags on the blade; explosive slashes
legendary_weapons.game_suggestion: Explosive melee with ammo (explosive tags) replenished at shops.

legendary_weapons.name: Kabutowari (Helmet Splitter)
legendary_weapons.description: Combination of an axe and a hammer connected by a chain; can break any defense
legendary_weapons.game_suggestion: Armor-break weapon: ignores block, shatters shields and ice/earth walls.

legendary_weapons.name: Hiramekarei (Twin Sword)
legendary_weapons.description: Twin-handled broad blade wrapped in bandages that stores chakra and releases it as shaped weapons
legendary_weapons.game_suggestion: Charge-store mechanic: store chakra, release as a hammer/sword shape AoE.

legendary_weapons.name: Gunbai / Fan-type war weapons
legendary_weapons.description: Large war fans that reflect attacks and generate wind
legendary_weapons.game_suggestion: Reflect projectiles back; wind gust knockback.

legendary_weapons.name: Chakra Blades / Trench Knives
legendary_weapons.description: Knuckle knives that channel wind chakra to extend cutting power
legendary_weapons.game_suggestion: Wind affinity weapon class; extends range per chakra infusion.

legendary_weapons.name: Chakra-conducting metal (ninjato)
legendary_weapons.description: Standard Anbu straight swords made of chakra-conductive metal

culture.description: Konoha's philosophy that the entire village is a family and that love of the village is passed from generation to generation; protecting the young ('the king') is the highest duty
culture.game_suggestion: Reputation/morale system: protective actions boost village bond, unlocking passive buffs near allies.

culture.description: Metal plate with village symbol on cloth; sign of ninja status after graduating the academy; worn on forehead, arm, waist, neck. Scratched line through the symbol marks a missing-nin
culture.game_suggestion: Customisable equipment slot (cloth color, position). Scratching it = defection choice that changes faction state.

culture.description: Protective vest with scroll pouches worn by chunin and jonin; varies by village
culture.game_suggestion: Rank-gated armor; equipped after chunin promotion.

culture.description: Academy student -> Genin -> Chunin (via Chunin Exam) -> Jonin / Special Jonin -> Kage; Anbu as special forces; missing-nin ranked by bingo book (D to S)
culture.game_suggestion: Core progression ladder; Chunin Exam as a major story event; Bingo Book bounty board.

culture.description: D-rank (chores), C-rank (escort, low danger), B, A, S (top secret, extremely dangerous); payment scaled accordingly
culture.game_suggestion: Mission board with rank requirements and ryo rewards.

culture.description: Currency used in the Naruto world, e.g. mission payments and bounties; items like ramen cost a few hundred ryo
culture.game_suggestion: Main currency; mission rewards, bounties, shops.

culture.description: Konoha has popular ramen stands (Ichiraku-style counter with noren curtains), barbecue restaurants, dango shops, tea houses; soldier pills and food pills for ninja
culture.game_suggestion: Food buffs (ramen = stamina regen, barbecue = strength, dango = speed); create original shops.

culture.description: Seasonal festivals with lanterns, yukata, food stalls, fireworks; Konoha festivals celebrate founding or heroes
culture.game_suggestion: Seasonal events with minigames (goldfish scooping, shuriken target booth), cosmetic yukata.

culture.description: Stone monument in a Konoha training ground where names of ninja killed in action are engraved; also the stone where 'heroes' are remembered
culture.game_suggestion: Place for quiet story moments; fallen companion NPCs' names added; permadeath mode memorial.

culture.description: Personal creed each ninja chooses and holds to, e.g. never going back on one's word
culture.game_suggestion: Character creation choice granting passive perk (e.g. 'Never give up': low-HP buff).

culture.description: Twelve zodiac hand seals (Rat, Ox, Tiger, Hare, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Ram, Monkey, Bird, Dog, Boar) used to mould chakra for jutsu
culture.game_suggestion: Seal input combos for jutsu casting (skill = faster sequences).

culture.description: Fire, Wind, Lightning, Earth, Water with a rock-paper-scissors relationship (Fire > Wind > Lightning > Earth > Water > Fire); chakra paper test reveals affinity
culture.game_suggestion: Elemental damage matrix; chakra paper affinity test at character creation.

culture.description: Hokage, Kazekage, Mizukage, Raikage, Tsuchikage lead villages under feudal daimyo
culture.game_suggestion: Political map with original Kage NPCs.

culture.description: Academy teaches basics (clone, transformation, substitution); Chunin Exams have a written test, survival test (Forest of Death), and a tournament
culture.game_suggestion: Tutorial region and first major story arc.

enemy_archetypes.name: Missing-nin of the Mist
enemy_archetypes.abilities: Hidden Mist Technique, silent killing, water clones, Water Prison, large swords
enemy_archetypes.game_suggestion: Fog encounters where visibility drops; swordsmen elite variant.

enemy_archetypes.name: Sound village ninja
enemy_archetypes.region: Land of Rice Fields / Sound hideouts
enemy_archetypes.abilities: Sound-wave attacks via arm devices, cursed seal transformations, poison, snake summons
enemy_archetypes.game_suggestion: Cursed-seal enemies with a second phase; underground lab dungeons.

enemy_archetypes.name: Bandits and Rogue Mercenaries
enemy_archetypes.abilities: Swords, simple taijutsu, ambushes, some low-rank ninja
enemy_archetypes.game_suggestion: Early-game random encounters on escort missions.

enemy_archetypes.name: Cloud ninja (Kumo)
enemy_archetypes.abilities: Lightning Release, sword arts, Lariat-style strong taijutsu
enemy_archetypes.game_suggestion: Fast, aggressive enemies; lightning shield mechanics.

enemy_archetypes.name: Stone ninja (Iwa)
enemy_archetypes.abilities: Earth Release walls, clay explosives, flight/weight jutsu
enemy_archetypes.game_suggestion: Defensive enemies with destructible walls; explosive clay specialists.

enemy_archetypes.name: Sand ninja and Puppeteers
enemy_archetypes.game_suggestion: Desert enemy packs with puppet adds.

enemy_archetypes.name: Rain ninja
enemy_archetypes.abilities: Rain-based sensing, umbrella senbon, breathing masks with gas

enemy_archetypes.name: Criminal syndicate duos (Akatsuki-inspired)
enemy_archetypes.abilities: S-rank, diverse kekkei genkai, coordinated pair attacks
enemy_archetypes.game_suggestion: Endgame boss pairs from an original organisation.
